label: one gate around both diagnostics
the +0x0a store is 32 bits wide
why: 0x4abdd is `66 c7 40 0a 00 00` -- `movw $0x0,0xa(%eax)`, a 16-bit store, so the object writes two bytes and this writes four. The two it also writes are +0x0c, which the very next statement sets to 0 anyway. EQUIVALENT ONLY BECAUSE OF THAT ORDER: swap the +0x0a and +0x0c statements, or put a read of +0x0c between them, and this becomes a real defect. It will then be CAUGHT and reported MIScounted, which is why it is registered rather than left as a note in a finding.
